During filling, water enters at \(20\) mL/min and drains at \(18\) mL/min, so the net increase is

\[
20-18=2\text{ mL/min}.
\]

Thus the volume increases at a steady rate at first. Once the birdbath reaches overflow level, the extra incoming water overflows, keeping the volume constant.

That matches graph \(A\): it rises linearly, then becomes horizontal.

The answer is A.
